## Services
- Wedding photography and candid photography
- Wedding videography and cinematic highlight films
- Pre-wedding photography
- Bridal portraits and engagement photography
- Wedding album design

## Wedding packages
- Essential: ₹35,000 — 4 hours, 1 photographer, 1 videographer, 200+ edited photos, printed album and private gallery.
- Premium: ₹75,000 — 8 hours, 2 photographers, 1 videographer, 400+ edited photos, 2 premium albums and a 3-minute highlight video.
- Luxury: ₹1,50,000 — full-day coverage, 2 photographers plus assistant, 2 videographers, unlimited photos, pre/post-wedding shoots and a cinematic highlight film.

Final pricing and availability depend on the event date, venue, coverage and selected deliverables. Confirm requirements with the studio.

## Referral program
- Referral commission amounts and payout milestones are confirmed in writing before an eligible referral is accepted.
- No fixed reward amount is promised on the public page.
- Referrers should obtain permission before sharing a prospective client’s contact details.
